# Type delivery table

One row per delivering ledger row: the source native type, the Arrow type batch writes, the change-stream verdict, and the column type `rivet load` builds in ClickHouse, BigQuery and Snowflake. `today` marks a row that ships a type other than its target (`known_defect` or a leg `defect`).

## Gaps per engine

| engine | delivering rows | matrix-only rows | rows with a defect | empty cells |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| postgres | 77 | 26 | 4 | 0 |
| mysql | 37 | 43 | 0 | 0 |
| mssql | 21 | 34 | 1 | 0 |
| oracle | 14 | 43 | 0 | 0 |
| mongo | 0 | 20 | 0 | 0 |

No cell is empty.

## Recovering a value that lands as INT64 nanoseconds on BigQuery

Rows: `mssql DATETIME2`, `mssql DATETIMEOFFSET`. `x` is the INT64 column.

| result | expression |
| --- | --- |
| instant | `TIMESTAMP_MICROS(DIV(x, 1000))` |
| datetime | `DATETIME(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(DIV(x, 1000)), 'UTC')` |
| sub microsecond ns | `MOD(x, 1000)` |
| instant before 1970 | `TIMESTAMP_MICROS(DIV(x, 1000) - IF(MOD(x, 1000) < 0, 1, 0))` |
| datetime before 1970 | `DATETIME(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(DIV(x, 1000) - IF(MOD(x, 1000) < 0, 1, 0)), 'UTC')` |
| sub microsecond ns before 1970 | `MOD(x, 1000) + IF(MOD(x, 1000) < 0, 1000, 0)` |
